BiblicalUsage: Tiria is named once, among the sons of Jehaleleel. The Chronicler lists Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asareel together, and the record gives no more than the name and the family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the one-line names are kept for a reason: every son is counted, even when his story is not told. The King James spells the name Tiria, where the lexicon has Tirja, and they are the same man.
